sottotitolo: Moves the children into next year’s classes. First look at the preview and fix it, then a person confirms: the changeover never starts by itself.
nessunAnno: Pick the new year, the one with open enrolments, from the selector at the top to do the changeover.
erroreRete: I can’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errorePermesso: You don’t have permission to see or run the year changeover.
erroreGenerico: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
nessunaAnteprima: There is no preview of the changeover for this year yet. Calculating it changes nothing: it only shows what would happen.
statoAnnullato: Changeover cancelled: the children are back as they were. You can redo the preview.
nonAncora: The changeover can be done from {data}.
nonAncoraNota: Meanwhile you can look at the preview and fix it.
correggiNo: For this child the class can’t be changed from here.
nonCorreggibile: To let this child continue, record the confirmation in “Confirmations”, then recalculate the preview.
daDecidereNota: These rows must be decided before confirming: as long as there are any, the “Confirm the changeover” button stays off.
avvisoRitiratoTendina: Marked as withdrawn but has a new enrolment: decide whether the child leaves or continues.
avvisoSenzaSezione: Has no new class yet: pick one or let the child leave.
riquadroNonRisposto: {n, plural, one {# family has not replied: if they do not confirm before the changeover, their child leaves.} other {# families have not replied: if they do not confirm before the changeover, their children leave.}} This is only a preview, nothing has changed.
cambiaGradoNota: «Change level» are children moving to another level, for example from nursery school to primary school. To mark a child who goes to primary school, open «Confirmations» and tick «Goes to primary school» on their row; then recalculate the preview.
rimandoConfermeNota: Children whose family didn’t reply but wants to continue are fixed from “Confirmations”: then the preview is recalculated.
docentiNota: These are the teachers of the old classes, copied onto the new ones. You can remove or add some. “Remove” applies to the new class: on the old class the teacher stays until you confirm. Someone already assigned to the new class from the class page stays assigned even if you remove them here. Archived accounts cannot be added.
azioneConfermaSpentaDecidere: The “To decide” rows must be decided first.
dialogoNonRisposto: {n, plural, one {# child whose family did not answer will leave.} other {# children whose families did not answer will leave.}}
dialogoEsce: {n, plural, one {# child leaves by choice of the family or the office.} other {# children leave by choice of the family or the office.}}
dialogoCambiaGrado: {n, plural, one {# child changes level.} other {# children change level.}}
dialogoFamiglie: From the start of the new year families will see the new class.
dialogoNota: You can cancel as long as nothing has been recorded in the new year (attendance, diary, photos and the like). Payments do not prevent it: the fees already created stay.
dialogoAnnullaCorpo: The children go back to how they were before the changeover. The copies of subjects and timetables stay. Late confirmations already recorded stay: the enrolment and the fee line belong to the family and must be removed by hand.
tardivaNota: A child who left and then confirmed is brought back from here, into the chosen class.
tardivaClasse: Class for the late confirmation of {nome}
dialogoFinestra: Families of children who continue see the class as it is now until {fino}; they see the new class from {dal}. The teacher of the new class already finds it open for writing, the old one stays read-only.
dialogoAccessoSubito: {n, plural, one {# child loses access to the families’ app right away and no longer appears in the teachers’ lists.} other {# children lose access to the families’ app right away and no longer appear in the teachers’ lists.}}
correggiRiporta: To keep them, choose the class
esitoScartata: The preview is discarded: calculate another one if needed.
rimandoSelettore: The changeover is prepared on the year with open enrolment: choose that year from the selector above.
rimandoApertura: Enrolment for this year is not open yet: the changeover can be calculated once it is. Open it from Settings, under “School year”, with “Yes, open enrolment”.
esitoDocenteRestaAssegnato: Removed from the transition list, but still assigned to the new class: the assignment is on the class page and is changed from there.
dialogoGiaCominciato: The new year has already started: families of children who continue see the new class right away, and those who leave lose access right away.
quoteSuUsciti: {n, plural, one {# fee is still unpaid for a child who leaves: the transition does not remove it.} other {# fees are still unpaid for children who leave: the transition does not remove them.}}
dialogoAnnullaStorico: The records have already moved to the new class since {dal}: cancelling returns them to the previous class, but in the class history the days already spent stay on the new class.
